description: This file defines the interface ToApiJsonSerializer used for serializing various Java objects into JSON format within the Fineract project. It contains method signatures for serializing individual objects, collections, and paginated data with optional settings and parameter support.

classes.name: ToApiJsonSerializer
classes.description: A generic interface for serializing objects of type T into JSON strings, supporting different serialization contexts and configurations.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a given object into JSON format.

methods.name: serializeResult
methods.description: Serializes the result object into JSON, typically for responses.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a collection of objects into JSON with specific serialization settings.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a single object of type T with specific settings.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a paginated collection of objects of type T with specific settings.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a collection with supported response parameters, used for partial responses.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a single object with supported response parameters.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a paginated object with supported response parameters.
